name: Clearfield County, PA
findings: Clearfield County has 239 nonprofit organizations. 103 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clearfield County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Clearfield County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 117 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
